findings.mechanism: Read-modify-write without SELECT FOR UPDATE or atomic UPDATE leads to lost updates under READ COMMITTED.
findings.remediation: Wrap balance update in SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or use atomic UPDATE statement with WHERE balance >= amount and RETURNING balance.
findings.arithmetic: Initial balance 100, 10 concurrent debits of 10 each. Ideal final 0, but if only one write persists final = 100-10=90. Thus final_balance >= 90 indicates lost update.

prediction.condition: 10 concurrent debits of 10.00 on initial balance 100.00
